comparison.objective: Lock out an air-conditioner disconnect, versus adjust and commission a locked-out robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a cover, extract/flip/reinsert a pull-out, insert a padlock, and latch it; the candidate instead uses a fine hex bit, moving collar socket, and test cycles.
comparison.success_condition: Correct disconnect remains OFF and its locked cover withstands a 20 N check; candidate requires repeatable bounded-energy carriage stops.
comparison.reason: Both use safe sequencing and locking, but their mechanisms and tested outcomes differ substantially.
